fields.statement: Verifier, attempt 2, at a511eec72 (detached checkout). The fix commit updates TestPlanBuiltin to the plan order review -> has-findings -> critic/fresh, which resolves the quality finding that internal/workflow was red. Ran with GOTMPDIR outside the worktree path: go test -count=1 -trimpath ./internal/workflow/... ok (incl. TestPlanBuiltin, TestPlanCleanRoundSkipsCritic, which reads both built-in plan and plan-milestone); go test -trimpath ./internal/api -run 'TestReviewCheckFindingsFlag|TestReviewCheck' PASS (clean or absent round fails review-check --findings, a round with a finding passes, run verdict with {"verdicts":[]} errors); go test -count=1 -trimpath ./cmd/rhiza -run TestScripts/(plan-workflow|plan-workflow-autonomous|plan-workflow-pr|plan-milestone-backlog|plan-review-visit-round|describe-golden) ok (plan-workflow-autonomous: review -> has-findings fail -> fresh -> check -> gate with no critic session; plan-workflow, plan-review-visit-round and plan-milestone-backlog: a round with findings goes to the critic). Diff read: both plan.toml and plan-milestone.toml add a has-findings command step running rhiza run review-check --findings, with on.pass critic and on.fail fresh. Note: plan-review-visit-round fails at line 46 only when GOTMPDIR contains the word critic (this checkout's path does), because $WORK appears in run status output. That comes from the environment, not from the change.
